scope: Pre-generation implementation evidence appendix; no model calls, no alteration of the frozen conditions reference

source.line_number_basis: The saved UTF-8 source above, numbered from 1; cached web extraction line numbers differ.

verified_facts.claim: The pinned Qwen3.5 renderer applies Go strings.TrimSpace to leading system content and each message content.
verified_facts.implication: HTTP message strings can remain byte-identical while their rendered boundary whitespace differs. Literal byte identity of every HTTP string inside the rendered prompt is a stricter condition than this official renderer implements.

verified_facts.claim: The renderer reads an explicit non-null think value through think.Bool().
verified_facts.implication: Disabled thinking is a renderer control; it does not establish that the model lacks reasoning ability.

verified_facts.claim: The Qwen3.5 assistant branch calls splitQwen35ReasoningContent; tagged reasoning can be removed from assistant content even when no think block is emitted.
verified_facts.implication: A boundary-whitespace-only validation exception must not silently authorize tag removal or other content changes. A mismatch outside the explicitly allowed boundary operation must stop the case.

pre_generation_validation_recommendation.raw_http_history: Keep complete assistant final-content strings, user strings, and calculator strings unchanged in saved and transmitted HTTP requests.
pre_generation_validation_recommendation.rendered_history: Check every message in order against the officially documented renderer boundary-whitespace operation, record original and rendered content hashes plus removed boundary characters, and reject all other omissions or transformations.
pre_generation_validation_recommendation.whitespace_semantics: If implementing Go TrimSpace, use its unicode.IsSpace character set exactly; Python str.strip() additionally recognizes some control characters. Alternatively allow only an explicitly limited ASCII boundary set and fail closed on other differences.
not_authorized: Reasoning-tag removal accepted as content preservation
pre_generation_validation_recommendation.context_limit: Render-only evidence shows the assembled text, not an independently measured token count. truncate=false avoids the wrapper's message-removal path; shift=false requests no context shifting. Save backend failure/stop evidence rather than infer exact context sufficiency from character or byte length.
pre_generation_validation_recommendation.evidence_level: Version-pinned official implementation and disclosed engineering validation policy, not a financial-paper experimental setting
